standard_prerequisites: The completion construction Y maps to Y_{/T} for algebraic spaces over the pair (X, T), as set up in the surrounding section of the source
The fppf sheaf property of the algebraic space X' and descent of morphisms along etale coverings
Formal algebraic spaces: the reduction of a completion is the reduced induced scheme on the closed subspace
core_obligations: Injectivity of the completion map Mor_X(Y, X') to Mor over X_{/T}, via agreement over the open g^{-1}U plus the faithful injectivity lemma of the same chapter
Existence of a preimage morphism a : Y to X' for any alpha : Y_{/T} to X'_{/T}, by etale descent and the agreement of completions on fibre products
A two-stage reduction of the existence problem to the affine case, finished by the rig-etale algebraization lemma of the same chapter
proof_roadmap: Injectivity: a and b over X' agree over g^{-1}U and after completion, hence agree by the chapter's faithful lemma

Gluing: for an etale covering {h_i : Y_i to Y} construct a_i locally, compare (a_i)_{/T} on overlaps using that completion commutes with fibre products, descend via injectivity and the fppf sheaf property
Reduction 1: shrink Y to affine etale over X so that alpha becomes a morphism of completions over an affine base

Reduction 2: on the affine case use the reduction of (Y_{/T}) to cover the quasi-compact image by an affine etale V over X', split Y into the etale covering {Y' to Y, Y minus g^{-1}T to Y}, and finish via the rig-etale algebraization lemma
